text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Who's today's main star?

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Friends
text_block_list.text: Toosen Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Who's got our hearts fluttering?

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Friends
text_block_list.text: Toosen Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And to wrap it all up...?

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Friends
text_block_list.text: Jordan, congrats on getting into Tracen Academyyy☆!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ayyy, thanksss☆!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: *(Ding-dong♪)*

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
All right, UmaTok video done! I'll post it later.
Burgers! Let's eat, let's eat, let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Friend A
text_block_list.text: Talk about an instant switch.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, my mom's super strict at home, so I can never eat junk like this.
Wait, hold up, aren't those gel nails totally slaying?! What's the tea?

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Right?! First-time discount for 1,500 yen, pretty sick, huh? Practically pocket change.
They gave me a referral coupon, so here. A gift for getting into school.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, seriously?! That legit makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
You're so easily pleased! Such a cutie.
Don't go changin' on us even after you start at Tracen, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Totally. Honestly, it's gonna be kinda lonely. Once you're gone,
that's the end of our regular squad, you know? ...Can't you just drop out? Like, right now?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, cut that out, for real! I worked my butt off to get in, you know!
My teacher even praised me for the first time ever. Said I actually had what it takes!

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, I get why your teacher was surprised.
You're kinda clumsy, or should I say, a total airhead.

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
You accidentally threw away your report card, burned the sports festival sign
with the rest of the trash... Weren't you writing apology letters like once a month?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Once a month is an exaggeration! It was like once every two months, tops!

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
That's basically the same thing! ...Well, whatever. You worked hard to get in,
so give it your all. We'll totally be cheerin' you on.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, thanks.
...Well, yeah. I guess so. I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I kinda feel like... if it's there, maybe I can actually pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few months later.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(—Today, I'm gonna win. For real.
Seriously, it's about time... I *have* to win.)

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Focus on the start, grab a solid position.
From there... don't let anyone mess up my pace—)

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *Inhale... exhale...!* —All right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While scoping out a mock race in search of a potential trainee,
I noticed the trainers around me whispering about one particular girl.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Look, that's Toosen Jordan. Did her hoof injury finally heal?
I heard she was in no condition to run, though.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It might be healed for now, but there's a high chance of relapse.
Even now, it seems like she keeps re-injuring it over and over...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Still, she doesn't seem ready to throw in the towel just yet. She was out there
yesterday running paired workouts on her own. ...Though you can tell she's rusty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Intrigued, I turned my attention toward the track.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: All runners are in the gates—and they're off!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-What?!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (What is this, my feet feel totally weightless...?! I gotta push down harder!)

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...No, something's off!
Normally I can dig in with way more power, so why—?)

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *Pant, pant...!* Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The leader rounds the fourth corner and enters the final straight!
The pack is heavily strung out!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Is she just off her game... or is she kind of slacking off out there?
She's trailing way behind everyone else...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toosen Jordan's oddly lifeless running stood out for all the wrong reasons...
and she crossed the finish line far behind the rest of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *Pant, pant, pant... ngh!*

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, I wonder what happened. Maybe her spirit finally broke.
Up until yesterday, she was trying so hard... I hope she's okay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether she heard the whispers or not, Toosen Jordan walked off,
and unable to shake my concern, I found myself following after her.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Dammit dammit dammit dammit dammit dammit dammit, DAMMITTT—!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *Pant, pant...* ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In stark contrast to her hollow stride on the track, the raw emotion
she hurled into the hollow of the old tree was completely genuine.
I couldn't get the sight of that contradictory girl out of my head.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few weeks later,
rumors began to circulate that Toosen Jordan had started avoiding races.
